Name: Font Settings
Author: Becks723
Description:
[size=5][b]中文：[/b][/size]
[spoiler]

这是一个出发点很简单的模组，就是让玩家得以设置游戏内字体。
模组中并没有包括某个具体的字体，所有字体来源于你的电脑，即：你下载了多少字体，就能用在游戏里多少字体。这避免了万恶的版权问题。


[size=5][b]下载&安装[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3] 下载并安装[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]。[/size]
[*][size=3] 下载此模组，文件如下所示：[/size]
[size=1]﻿（必下）[/size][size=3]主文件：[/size]
﻿ [size=2][i]FontSettings x.x.x.zip﻿[/i] 解压并放入[i]Mods[/i]文件夹。[/size]
[size=1]（可选）[/size][size=3]原版字体文件：[/size]
﻿ [size=2]以下为各个语言的原版字体文件。用于在保持原版字体的情况下，修改大小/字间距/行间距等。解压放入[b]本模组[/b][i]assets/fonts[/i]文件夹。
﻿ 中：[i]vanilla font file for Chinese[/i]
日：[i]vanilla font file for Japanese[/i]
韩：[i]vanilla font file for Korean[/i][/size]
[*][size=3]完成！[/size]
[/list]
﻿除普通下载方式外，我还放了个百度网盘的链，就在头上的[b]Mirrors[/b]里。


[b][size=5]使用[/size][/b]
﻿[s]见 附在模组中的 [/s][i]说明.txt [/i][s]文件。[/s]
在线文档：[s]﻿[/s][s]﻿﻿[/s][url=https://gitee.com/becks723/my-stardew-valley-mods/blob/master/FontSettings/README-zh.md]gitee[/url] | [url=https://github.com/Becks723/StardewMods/blob/master/FontSettings/README-zh.md]github[/url]


[size=5][b]反馈[/b][/size]
﻿如果你遇到了报错（比如字体设置失败、smapi红字），请联系作者！由于目前处于测试版，欢迎你向我提出问题！


[size=5][b]鸣谢[/b][/size]
[url=https://smapi.io/]﻿SMAPI[/url]
[url=https://github.com/StbSharp/StbTrueTypeSharp]StbTrueTypeSharp[/url]
[url=http://www.angelcode.com/products/bmfont/]bmfont
[/url]
[/spoiler]


[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][size=3] Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/size]
[*][size=3] Download this mod from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12467?tab=files]Files tab[/url] and install. Mod files are shown as follows:[/size]
[size=1]﻿(Required) [/size][size=3]Main files:[/size]
﻿ [size=2][i]FontSettings x.x.x.zip﻿[/i] Unzip and put into [i]Mods[/i] folder.[/size]
[size=1](Optional) [/size][size=3]Optional files:[/size]
﻿ [size=2]﻿Following are font files game uses for each language. Download if you want to keep original font but with size/spacing/linespacing change. Unzip and put into [b]this mod's[/b] [i]assets/fonts[/i] folder.
﻿ [i]vanilla font file for Chinese[/i]
[i]vanilla font file for Japanese[/i]
[i]vanilla font file for Korean[/i][/size]
[*][size=3] Done![/size]
[/list]


[size=5][b]Usage[/b][/size]
Click the font button in title menu, or through hotkey (default [i]LeftAlt + F[/i]) to open Font Settings menu.
Configure the fonts, then click OK, your font is set!


[size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Works with Windows, MacOS, Linux. Android version is under development.


[size=5][b]Configure[/b][/size]
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GenericModConfigMenu[/url]!
See on [url=https://github.com/Becks723/StardewMods/blob/master/FontSettings/README.md#configuration]github[/url].


[size=5][b]See also[/b][/size]
This description page may not be updated in time.
For a more detailed and in-time docs, see on [url=https://github.com/Becks723/StardewMods/blob/master/FontSettings/README.md]github[/url].
